apiContracts: This slice adds pure policy and metadata helpers only; no Worker route is activated.

migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Additive pure modules; runtime integration is deferred to a separate governed change.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert these modules and their tests; no data repair.

uiLifecycle.ssrBehavior: No Worker SSR wiring is changed in this slice.

privacySecurity.ownerScoping: Discovery graph builder only accepts supplied public catalog projections; callers must supply rights-filtered data.

integration: Existing dynamic sitemap and public-rights eligibility tests remain mandatory.
isolation: No account data or private chapter body ingestion.

stagingSteps: Verify robots, sitemap, canonical and JSON-LD against real published content before activation.

collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: package.json remains repository-operations-owned; ownership registry updated for all new paths.

changeSummary: Ports isolated SEO metadata/sitemap/crawler policy helpers, public discovery graph construction and rights-aware publication-quality assessment from PR #120 with focused regression tests. Does not wire new routes or change database/runtime behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: All added files have exactly one owner.
SEO helpers encode private-route noindex and crawler policy defaults.
Discovery graph excludes invalid novels and orphan relationships.
Publication quality requires valid metadata, rights and published chapter content.
All tests are mandatory in npm run build.
No routes, migrations, browser bundles or production configuration change.
